purpose: Smiling individual study-completion and capsule-card portraits

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: dedicated celebratory portrait for a study-completion report and a shareable study capsule card. Generate a NEW single-character illustration using input image 1 ONLY as an identity, outfit, and rendering-style reference, not as a composition to copy. Match the same recognizable face, hair, detailed soft anime rendering and school outfit. Eye-level, modest waist-up framing, complete head and hair inside the frame. Portrait 1024x1536. The person is slightly right of center, with the smiling face around x=65%, y=40%; keep some quiet softly lit background in the upper-left for a separately overlaid title asset. Face and expression must remain clear when cropped to a landscape card. A genuinely bright, happy post-study smile with smiling eyes. Natural anatomy and relaxed hands. Fully covered torso with a properly worn white collared shirt and dark tie; no revealing clothing or exaggerated body proportions. No other people, no text, name tag lettering, speech bubbles, title, logos, watermark, UI or graphic badges. The output is a finished opaque illustration with its own atmospheric background.
Subject: Chaerin, the reference's long pale-blonde-haired friend with gray eyes. Preserve her white long-sleeved shirt, dark tie and glossy blonde hair; do not add a sweater. Her reserved personality softens into a radiant, slightly bashful smile showing a little teeth, cheeks lightly warm. She holds a closed notebook naturally against her torso with one arm and gives a small friendly wave with the other. Mood: a private, warm 'we did well today' moment. Background: the familiar classroom bathed in honey-gold sunset, soft peach sky through windows, gentle luminous dust in the light. Warm amber and blush palette, polished softly painted anime art. Keep the smile and affectionate eye contact the focus.
